meta.title: Delulu Dating — How delulu is your HK boyfriend wishlist?
meta.description: Stack dating deal-breakers against Hong Kong stats. Sharp, dumb, not a matchmaker.

landing.headline: How tight is your boyfriend filter in Hong Kong?
landing.sub: You stack deal-breakers. We show how fast the pool vanishes. Sharp, dumb, honest.
landing.liveCounterSub: How many people ran their filters today (site counter, not Census).
landing.recentEmpty: No saved runs yet. Finish a quiz and it lands here.
landing.disclaimer: Model + public statistics. For perspective, not certainty.
landing.heroBody: Pile on age, height, income, and more. Public HK stats multiplied to show joint odds — and who's left in your pool.
landing.heroImageAlt: Hong Kong skyline at night, high contrast
landing.process1Body: Walk through one screen per filter: must-have or don't care. No chat logs — just the deal-breakers you declare, saved locally until you calculate.
landing.process2Body: We combine Census 2021 shares, earnings percentiles, a height curve from the 2014/15 Population Health Survey, and blunt priors for flat and car — then multiply filters with a +12% correlation bump so tall + rich isn't astronomically worse than naive independence.
landing.process3Body: You get match odds (about 1 in N HK men), a remaining pool count, a delulu tier, and a breakdown of which filter cuts hardest — plus a shareable result if you want group chat judgment.
landing.specimensSub: Runs saved in this browser from the last few sessions. Tap one to reopen your filters and jump to the result.
landing.specimenQuote: "The objectivity of spreadsheets meets the tragedy of the heart."
landing.ctaClosingSub: Nine nosy questions. One mean ratio. Screenshot responsibly.
landing.footerLegal: © Delulu Lab HK — objectivity is a choice. Model outputs are illustrative, not predictions about any real person.
landing.footerBlurb: Public Hong Kong stats multiplied by your deal-breakers. Zero inboxes, zero promises, maximum side-eye.

quiz.heightHint: Mean HK male height in government health stats is ~170 cm (2014/15 survey — still the clean published bundle we model from).
quiz.incomeHint: HK$100k+/mo is roughly top 2–3% of male earners.
quiz.flatHint: A harsh filter in Hong Kong. This means he owns his place (private), not family titled, not “we’ll figure it out later”.
quiz.carHint: Private car in HK is rarer than drama make it sound. Toy share in the model, not a BMW salesperson quote.
quiz.labMonthlyBand: Monthly threshold (HKD only — we're not pretending USD fixes your crush)
quiz.labDataSource: Sources: C&SD / CHP priors. Methodology page has receipts.
quiz.labStepHeight_line2: 著高跟鞋嘅不算喺呢度補
quiz.labStepLifestyle_line2: 烟仔同前度小朋友，剔唔剔？
quiz.labStepCar_line2: 要泊车证定要情绪价值？
quiz.roastAge_tight: That's a razor-thin age gap. Efficient for apps, ruthless for probability — you're speed-running filtering.
quiz.roastAge_mid: Classic dating-window behaviour. Census nods politely; your situationship history does not.
quiz.roastAge_wide: Generous range — statistically kind, emotionally still a buffet. The model appreciates the mercy.
quiz.roastHeight_chill: Height bar still has oxygen in the room. Enjoy the moment before income shows up.
quiz.roastHeight_mid: You're flirting with the government mean and losing friends in group chat simultaneously.
quiz.roastHeight_tall: Strict vertical policy. ICAC can't arrest you for this, but the bell curve might.
quiz.roastHeight_skyscraper: IFC energy. The curve says "lol"; your heart says "but 6ft on Hinge".
quiz.roastIncome_floor: Modest money bar — you're playing on survival mode instead of nightmare mode.
quiz.roastIncome_normal: Mid-band hustle requirement. Hong Kong rent sends its regards.
quiz.roastIncome_comfy: Comfortable-comp cohort. The wage curve starts sweating here.
quiz.roastIncome_elite: Elite-band salaries. The percentile line just sent a 'typing…' bubble and ghosted.
quiz.roastIncome_unicorn: Unicorn money floor. Statistically you're not fishing — you're spearfishing with a spreadsheet.
quiz.roastMarital_never: Never-married-only is a sharp knife. Papers shrink; drama narratives expand.
quiz.roastMarital_now: Single-now includes real life — paperwork messy, math slightly kinder than never-only.
quiz.roastMarital_any: Open marital stance. Rare diplomatic win for the joint-probability monster.
quiz.roastExpat_any: No background filter — everyone stays in the pool.
quiz.roastExpat_local: Hong Kong–raised preference — trims the international slice (~5% of the pool).
quiz.roastExpat_intl: International preference — you're fishing in a smaller slice (~5% of HK's dating pool).
quiz.roastDistrict_any: All districts allowed — geography isn't your villain today (yet).
quiz.roastDistrict_few: A curated shortlist of hoods. You're not picky, you're… cartographically selective.
quiz.roastDistrict_many: Half the map is lit. MTR distance is a love language; probability disagrees.
quiz.roastEdu_any: Education-agnostic — today you'll offend LinkedIn, not the model.
quiz.roastEdu_degree: Degree floor engaged. Certificate frames echo loudly in an empty pool.
quiz.roastEdu_postgrad: Postgrad-or-bust. The Venn diagram whispers "delulu" in MLA format.
quiz.roastLife_both: Non-smoker + no kids-from-prev — tidy palette, fewer rows left in the spreadsheet.
quiz.roastLife_smokeOnly: Smoke veto on, kid story negotiable — lungs matter more than lore today.
quiz.roastLife_kidsOnly: Kid veto on, smoke negotiable — you're optimising for different plot twists.
quiz.roastLife_chaos: Full chaos mode — you're letting priors fight each other in the model Thunderdome.
quiz.roastFlat_must: Must-own-flat — Hong Kong mode: brutal, iconic, statistically expensive.
quiz.roastFlat_ok: Rent-is-fine — you just bought the pool a drink. Don't tell the property agents.
quiz.roastCar_must: Car must-have — in HK that's a personality trait with a licence plate.
quiz.roastCar_ok: Car optional — sanity prevails; tunnel toll trauma deferred.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.badge: Public stats only — no crystal ball
methodology.intro: Delulu Dating multiplies independent population filters. It's a Fermi estimate for dating — not a prediction about any individual human.
methodology.b1: Independent filters are multiplied (joint probability under independence). A +12% correlation uplift stops “tall + rich” stacks from being astronomically harsher than a naive model.
methodology.b2: Census doesn't publish “mean male height” every year. We use the Population Health Survey (2014/15) male mean (169.5 cm) plus a literature SD (~5.8 cm) for the bell curve. Newer self-reported app polls inflate height — we keep the boring government curve until CHP publishes a replacement bundle.
methodology.b3: Census and Statistics Department Annual Earnings and Hours Survey — male wage percentile curve (HK$), interpolated between published points.
methodology.b4: 2021 Census and thematic reports (simplified age-window and never-married proxies).
methodology.b6: Broad CHP / survey priors — rounded, not bespoke matchmaking intel.
methodology.b7: Blunt priors on common deal-breakers. Must own flat keeps about 11% of modeled men. Must keep a car keeps about 24%. Not estate agency research.
methodology.b8: ~5.5% of the modeled pool for “international / non-local-raised” backgrounds — in the ballpark of Hong Kong's non-Chinese and foreign-born share (Census 2021 ethnic minorities ~8%, deflated because that headline covers all ages and our pool is already narrowed). Not passport policing.
methodology.outro: This tool is a playful model built from public statistics. Use it as perspective, not fate.
